ruleset.name: Some Googly Eyes advisory trial
ruleset.description: Suggestions for agent review, not requirements to rewrite code or reduce metric scores. Review code-conventions.md and code-review-decisions.md before assessing findings. Each finding needs a disposition and a reason; retain rejected and overlapping findings. Framework invocation, coherent deep classes, and repeated wiring can be intentional. Metric properties use the pinned PMD version's defaults.
